title: Interior range of the polynomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. For every $p$ with $0<p<1$, the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
